statement.zh: **事件**：FIPS 203/204/205 发布（FIPS 203-205 Published）。三份标准同期定稿：FIPS 203 公告页记为「Published: August 13, 2024 Effective: August 13, 2024」，封面日期行则是「Published August 13, 2024」，其内容为模块格基密钥封装机制标准（ML-KEM）；FIPS 204 与 FIPS 205 的公告页同样记录 2024 年 8 月 13 日发布并即时生效，分别规定 ML-DSA 与 SLH-DSA。
statement.en: **Event**: FIPS 203-205 Published.It is registered under post-quantum cryptography, dated 2024.

statement.zh: IR 8547 §1 说明发布动机：「In response, NIST has released three PQC standards to provide the foundation for the transition to post-quantum cryptography」，并在 §2.1.1 写明「FIPS 204 and 205 each specify quantum-resistant digital signature schemes」，其中 ML-DSA 源自 CRYSTALS-Dilithium 提交、SLH-DSA 源自 SPHINCS+ 提交；这份 2026 年 10 月的文件在 §4.1.2 记录，就其自身的时点而言「ML-KEM is the only approved post-quantum key-establishment scheme based on public-key cryptography」。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in post-quantum cryptography, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 生效方式与选型背景写在标准自身：公告第 11 项规定「This standard becomes effective immediately upon final publication」，§1.2 记录「After three rounds of evaluation and analysis, NIST selected the first four algorithms for standardization」，并说明本标准规定的是所选算法 CRYSTALS-KYBER 的一个变体。
statement.en: Fix the object and its aliases; list the sourced dates, roles, parameters or inscriptions; state the observable output; then test the boundary.Any step without a source stops there rather than being filled with prose.

statement.zh: 定稿不等于工作完成：IR 8547 §2.1.2 记录第四轮又评了其他 KEM，「NIST selected HQC as an alternative to ML-KEM」且「A FIPS that specifies HQC-KEM is under development」；§4 规定量子脆弱的公钥密码 2030 年后弃用、2035 年后在 NIST 标准与指南下禁止使用，因此三份标准只是迁移的起点而非终点。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.

statement.zh:
从草案到定稿的间隔可在文本中定位：FIPS 203 附录 C.2 提到其内容曾被收入初始公开草案（ipd），该稿「was posted on August 24, 2023」，而正式版发布于 2024 年 8 月 13 日；FIPS 205 的封面日期同为 2024 年 8 月 13 日。**时间线、证据与争议**

登记年份为 2024；背景是后量子中此前技术、机构与冲突的累积；过程只写有来源支持的参与者、地点与行动；结果写它改变了哪些标准、机器、课程或政策；争议写二手叙述与一手材料的差距。来源包括：Wikipedia search entry for FIPS 203/204/205 发布；A Brief History of Cryptology and Cryptographic Algorithms (Dooley, Springer 2013)。
statement.en: Registered period: Post-quantum Era.The registered year is 2024; institutional placement and technical detail follow the cited sources.
